data_description.language: Language for recipes, prompts and notifications. Independent of the Home Assistant language.
data_description.units: How amounts are written in the shopping list.
data_description.shopping_targets: To-do lists that receive the ingredients when you confirm the menu.
data_description.ai_task_entity: Used to suggest recipes when ICA recipes do not fit. Leave empty to skip AI suggestions.

data_description.generation_day: The menu is drafted on this day for the following week.
data_description.dinner_days: Days of the week that need a dinner.

data_description.person: Optional. Links the member to a Home Assistant person.
data_description.allergies: Hard rule: recipes with these ingredients are never suggested. Pick from the list or type your own.
data_description.dislikes: Avoided when possible. Type and press enter.
data_description.likes: Preferred when possible. Type and press enter.
data_description.attends: Days this person eats dinner at home.
data_description.cook_separately: On: a recipe containing this person's allergen can still be used when that ingredient can be swapped and cooked in clean, separate pans. Off: such recipes are never suggested. Turn off for severe allergies.

data.max_split_days: Dinners cooked in more than one version (at most)

data_description.style_tags: Recipes matching more of these are ranked higher.
data_description.vegetarian_days: Followed when enough suitable recipes exist.
data_description.fish_min: Followed when enough suitable recipes exist.
data_description.max_split_days: When someone cannot eat an ingredient (meat for a vegetarian, cream for a dairy allergy, pasta for gluten), a dinner can still be used if that ingredient can be swapped: they get an adjusted version. This limits how often per week.

data_description.sources: Sources are asked in a fixed order: store recipes first, then AI.

data_description.notify_targets: Notify services such as mobile_app_your_phone. Buttons for Open, Confirm and Regenerate work with the Home Assistant app.
data_description.notify_events: Problems are sent separately, for example when a recipe source fails.

data_description.shopping_targets: To-do lists that receive the ingredients when you confirm the menu.
data_description.review_list: Items a shopping provider could not place end up here, so nothing is lost. Leave empty to skip.
data_description.pantry_staples: Never added to the lists (matched on whole words, so 'salt' also covers 'salt och peppar'). Substitutes bought for a diet or allergy are never skipped.

account.title: Store account
account.description: Your ICA shopping list is used through the same login as the ICA app. ICA only answers connections from Sweden, so Home Assistant needs a Swedish IP address. This uses ICA's app interface, which is not official and may change.

data_description.ica_personnummer: The same login as the ICA app (10 or 12 digits). BankID-only accounts do not work. Leave empty to switch ICA off.
data_description.ica_password: Stored in Home Assistant's configuration. Leave empty to keep the saved one.
data_description.ica_list_mode: A new list for every week's menu, or one list that is added to.
data_description.ica_list_name: Only for a fixed list. Created if it does not exist.

generate_menu.name: Generate menu
generate_menu.description: Drafts a dinner menu for a week, replacing any existing draft.

week_start.name: Week start
week_start.description: Any date in the week. Defaults to next week.

hint.name: Hint
hint.description: A wish for the whole menu. Only some sources use it (AI Task does).

set_recipe.name: Set recipe
set_recipe.description: Picks one of the alternatives for a day and locks it.

recipe_id.name: Recipe ID
recipe_id.description: Id of one of the day's alternatives (see the weekday sensor).

regenerate_day.name: Regenerate day
regenerate_day.description: Replaces one dinner with a new one that fits the rest of the week. Locked days are refused.

hint.name: Hint
hint.description: What you would like instead, for example 'something with fish'. Only some sources use it.

swap_days.name: Swap days
swap_days.description: Swaps two dinners of the same week. Both must suit who eats on their new day.

lock_day.name: Lock day
lock_day.description: Locks a dinner so regenerating the menu keeps it, or unlocks it.

confirm_menu.name: Confirm menu
confirm_menu.description: Locks the menu. Defaults to the latest draft.

week_start.name: Week start
week_start.description: Any date in the week to confirm.

add_to_shopping.name: Add to shopping
add_to_shopping.description: Tries again with the items of a confirmed menu that could not be delivered, or builds and sends the whole list again.

week_start.name: Week start
week_start.description: Any date in the week. Defaults to the latest confirmed menu.

everything.name: Everything
everything.description: Send the whole list again, which can create duplicates on the lists.

set_member.name: Set family member
set_member.description: Adds a family member, or changes one. Found by id, otherwise by name. Fields you leave out keep their value. Applies to menus made from now on.

name.name: Name
name.description: The member's name. Required for a new member.

id.name: ID
id.description: Identifies an existing member, so it can be renamed.

person.name: Person
person.description: A Home Assistant person to link to.

allergies.name: Allergies
allergies.description: Allergen keys (gluten, milk, lactose, egg, fish, crustaceans, molluscs, peanuts, tree_nuts, soy, sesame, celery, mustard, lupin, sulphites) or your own words.

attends.name: Eats dinner on
attends.description: Weekdays: mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat, sun.

cook_separately.name: Allergens can be cooked separately
cook_separately.description: Off means recipes with this person's allergens are never suggested.

remove_member.name: Remove family member
remove_member.description: Removes a family member, found by id or by name.
